method: Direct view_image inspection of six original Windows framebuffer PNGs; no image modification or new Godot execution.

frames.observed: Bright Play decks, rear trusses and broad lower void are visibly distinct; Overview actor is small.
Connected cavern surfaces surround a large void; central orange rear gantry can be mistaken for a usable floor.
Source, explicit selection mask and native-ID proposal are clearly labeled; actual Scripted rectangle [128,128,512,320] is visible.
Selected-stage native Before/After and composite proposal are explicit; text separates complete atmosphere replacement approval.
Native diagonal facade texture is present without atmosphere.
Sparse rain and haze preserve route silhouettes in the matched still frame; motion quality is not inferred.

limits: Select Play then Flat or Solo to distinguish decorative rear beams from collision geometry.
Overview does not show actor movement at a useful inspection scale.
Static frames do not prove full route traversal, physical Windows display scaling, NVIDIA frame pacing, or owner aesthetic acceptance.
